dimensions.assessment: Affects Members of Congress, congressional staff, candidates, immediate family members, government agencies, and commercial data brokers.
dimensions.evidence: at-risk individual means-- (A) a Member of Congress; (B) any individual who is the spouse, parent, sibling, or child

dimensions.assessment: Prohibits data brokers from selling personal data and mandates government agencies and businesses remove covered information within 72 hours upon request.
dimensions.evidence: It shall be unlawful for a data broker to knowingly sell, license, trade for consideration, or purchase covered information

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state or imply specific federal spending, revenue, or economic impacts.
Creates new legal restrictions, data removal mandates for government agencies and private businesses, and a new civil cause of action for injunctive or declaratory relief.
dimensions.evidence: An at-risk individual whose covered information is made public... may bring an action seeking injunctive or declaratory relief

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory restrictions on data brokers, businesses, and government agencies regarding the handling of covered personal information.
dimensions.evidence: Permanent statutory restrictions on data brokers, businesses, and government agencies.

missing_information: Administrative implementation costs for government agencies complying with removal requests.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill protects sensitive personal information of Members of Congress, congressional staff, candidates, and their families by restricting government agencies and data brokers from publicly posting or selling such information, while providing individual redress.
